title: Oriented Imagery Extension
description: STAC Oriented Imagery Extension for STAC Items and STAC Collections, based on the ArcGIS Oriented Imagery data model.

oi:name.description: Optional alias name that identifies the oriented image.

oi:camera_heading.description: Camera heading in degrees. North is 0 degrees and positive rotation is clockwise. -999 may be used when the orientation is unknown.

oi:camera_pitch.description: Camera pitch in degrees. 0 degrees is vertically down, 90 degrees is horizontal, and 180 degrees is vertically up.

oi:camera_height.description: Height of the camera above the ground in meters.

oi:horizontal_field_of_view.description: Horizontal field of view of the camera in degrees.

oi:vertical_field_of_view.description: Vertical field of view of the camera in degrees.

oi:near_distance.description: Nearest usable distance of the imagery from the camera position in meters.

oi:far_distance.description: Farthest usable distance of the imagery from the camera position in meters.

oi:camera_offset.description: X and Y offset between the actual camera location and the feature point.

oi:oriented_imagery_type.description: Type of oriented imagery represented by the item.

oi:image_rotation.description: Additional image rotation in degrees relative to the camera orientation. This rotation is added to camera roll.

oi:orientation_accuracy.description: Orientation accuracy represented as eight semicolon-delimited standard deviation values in the order: camera XY, camera Z, camera heading, camera pitch, camera roll, near distance, far distance, terrain elevation.

oi:matrix.description: Row-wise rotation matrix defining the transformation from image space to map space. Nine floating-point values.

oi:focal_length.description: Focal length of the camera lens.

oi:principal_x.description: X-coordinate of the principal point of autocollimation. Uses the same unit as focal length.

oi:principal_y.description: Y-coordinate of the principal point of autocollimation. Uses the same unit as focal length.

oi:radial.description: Radial lens distortion coefficients K1, K2, and K3.

oi:tangential.description: Tangential lens distortion coefficients P1 and P2.

oi:a0.description: A0 coefficient of the affine transformation from ground space to image space.

oi:a1.description: A1 coefficient of the affine transformation from ground space to image space.

oi:a2.description: A2 coefficient of the affine transformation from ground space to image space.

oi:b0.description: B0 coefficient of the affine transformation from ground space to image space.

oi:b1.description: B1 coefficient of the affine transformation from ground space to image space.

oi:b2.description: B2 coefficient of the affine transformation from ground space to image space.

oi:sequence_order.description: Unique sequence number or string used to control sequential navigation through oriented imagery.

oi:maximum_distance.description: Maximum search distance used when querying the oriented imagery dataset. Measured in meters.

oi:coverage_percentage.description: Percentage used to modify the computed image ground footprint. Negative values reduce the footprint and positive values increase it.

oi:elevation_source.description: Elevation source configuration used by the oriented imagery dataset.

url.description: URL of the elevation source, typically an ArcGIS ImageServer or other elevation service.

lod.description: Level of detail or zoom level used when requesting elevation data.

raster_function.description: Raster function processing template applied to the elevation source.

constant_elevation.description: Constant ground elevation used when a constant elevation is configured.

oi:time_interval_unit.description: Time unit used when filtering oriented imagery.

oi:camera_heading.description: Camera heading in degrees. North is 0 degrees and positive rotation is clockwise. -999 may be used when the orientation is unknown.

oi:camera_pitch.description: Camera pitch in degrees. 0 degrees is vertically down, 90 degrees is horizontal, and 180 degrees is vertically up.

oi:camera_height.description: Height of the camera above the ground in meters.

oi:horizontal_field_of_view.description: Horizontal field of view of the camera in degrees.

oi:vertical_field_of_view.description: Vertical field of view of the camera in degrees.

oi:near_distance.description: Nearest usable distance of the imagery from the camera position in meters.

oi:far_distance.description: Farthest usable distance of the imagery from the camera position in meters.

oi:oriented_imagery_type.description: Type of oriented imagery represented by the item.

oi:image_rotation.description: Additional image rotation in degrees relative to the camera orientation. This rotation is added to camera roll.

oi:orientation_accuracy.description: Orientation accuracy represented as eight semicolon-delimited standard deviation values in the order: camera XY, camera Z, camera heading, camera pitch, camera roll, near distance, far distance, terrain elevation.

oi:image_path_prefix.description: Prefix used to build the image path together with the image reference field.

oi:image_path_suffix.description: Suffix used to build the image path together with the image reference field.

oi:depth_image_path_prefix.description: Prefix used to build the depth image path together with the depth image reference field.

oi:depth_image_path_suffix.description: Suffix used to build the depth image path together with the depth image reference field.

oi:dem_path_prefix.description: Prefix used to build the digital elevation model path.

oi:dem_path_suffix.description: Suffix used to build the digital elevation model path.

oi:image_geometry_field.description: Field containing image-space geometry for features overlaid on oriented imagery.

oi:image_reference_field.description: Field containing the unique reference ID of the oriented image associated with an overlaid feature.

oi:reference_id_field.description: Field containing the unique reference ID of the oriented image on which a feature was captured.

oi:sequence_order_field.description: Field containing sequence numbers used to control sequential navigation.

oi:vertical_search_range.description: Maximum vertical search distance used when querying dataset features. Measured in meters.

oi:asset_type.description: Role of the asset within the oriented imagery item.
